messages.text:
Hello!

I was on vacation last week when Karina's laptop was set up. So just wanted to give you all the BIGGEST THANK YOU I've ever given anyone in my life for getting her set up with this! lol

She's needed this laptop for SO long, and I can't tell you how much time and energy this is saving GPT.

Appreciate you! :heart_hands::skin-tone-4:
